analysis.current_implementation: src/dashboard/App.jsx is 643 lines containing insights computation, filter logic, four view tabs (graph/bipartite/map/table), header, and footer. TRACKING_PLATFORMS is an exported const at the top of src/lib/pixel-detector.js (788 lines) and is imported by 7 dashboard files (App.jsx, BipartiteGraph.jsx, RadialGraph.jsx, DataTable.jsx, PlatformStats.jsx, HelpSheet.jsx) and 1 test file.
analysis.limitations: App.jsx is far above the 400-line target (643 lines). The platform catalog co-located with detection logic forces dashboard files to import a library file for a pure data structure, conflating concerns.
analysis.change_surface: 9 files. Create new module (e.g., src/lib/tracking-platforms.js or src/dashboard/data/platforms.js) holding TRACKING_PLATFORMS; update 7 dashboard imports + 1 test import; extract a TabNav / InsightsBanner subcomponent from App.jsx; collapse the conditional render into a view switch.
analysis.root_cause: Single-responsibility violation: App.jsx mixes orchestration, data reduction, JSX composition, and presentation; pixel-detector.js mixes detection logic with static catalog data, so 8 consumer files are coupled to a library module for lookups only.

options.name: Minimal catalog move + tab shell extract
options.summary: Move TRACKING_PLATFORMS to src/lib/tracking-platforms.js (or src/dashboard/data/platforms.js) and extract a TabNav component. Leave insights inline in App.jsx.
files_to_modify: src/lib/pixel-detector.js (remove TRACKING_PLATFORMS export, re-export from new module for back-compat)
pros: Smallest diff that closes F-CLEAN-002 and F-CLEAN-003
Catalog data module is reusable and testable in isolation
cons: App.jsx still over 400 lines until insights are also extracted
options.risk_details: Pure refactor: data moves, no behavior change. Re-export from pixel-detector.js can preserve back-compat for any consumer not yet updated.

options.name: Full split: catalog + insights + tab shell
options.summary: Move catalog; extract InsightsBanner (with displayedInsights computation) into its own component, leaving App.jsx as pure orchestration.
files_to_modify: src/dashboard/App.jsx (extract insights, tab shell, view switch map)
pros: Brings App.jsx comfortably under the 400-line target
Each extracted component is independently testable
cons: Larger diff; risks breaking 1.0 acceptance criteria for the F-CLEAN-002 verification
options.risk_details: Insights computation depends on stats and footprints state; extracting it requires careful hook placement and stable prop contracts.
